mapper.select: SELECT ddps.id, shares.dates, shares.pkg, shares.version, shares.invitation_num, shares.fill_code_num, shares.total_user_num, ddps.create_time, ddps.update_time from (SELECT dusr.dates, dusr.pkg, dusr.version, count(CASE dusr.source WHEN 1 THEN dusr.source END) invitation_num, count(CASE dusr.source WHEN 0 THEN dusr.source END) fill_code_num, COUNT(1) total_user_num FROM dwd_user_share_record dusr WHERE dusr.dates = #{dates} GROUP BY dusr.dates, dusr.pkg, dusr.version) shares LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_all_share ddps on (ddps.dates = shares.dates and ddps.pkg = shares.pkg and ddps.version = shares.version)
